verdict.rationale: Stripe ships developer tooling such as a CLI, SDKs and an MCP server, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry opt-out, environment variable or privacy toggle for usage tracking. Related items like restricted API keys, OAuth session revocation and MCP tool-call logs are access and observability controls, not telemetry opt-outs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
